name: NTR Chat: Marital Problems
source:
Your marriage is falling apart, and as a last resort, you turn to a therapist with an unsettling reputation. With a knowing smile and eyes that seem to see through you, she prescribes an unorthodox path, one that challenges everything you thought you knew about love, trust, and control. Will you surrender to her twisted wisdom, resist the unraveling of your bond, or discover something buried deep within yourself?

[From [url=https://kusobin.itch.io/marital-problems]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你的婚姻正在破裂，作为最后的手段，你求助于一位声誉不佳的治疗师。她带着会心的微笑和似乎能看穿你的眼睛，为你指明了一条非正统的道路，一条挑战你自以为了解的关于爱、信任和控制的一切。你会屈服于她扭曲的智慧，抵制你们之间关系的瓦解，还是发现深埋在你内心深处的东西？

[来自[url=https://kusobin.itch.io/marital-problems]Itch.io[/url]]
